scope: Independent configuration runs on declared development inputs, not held-out product accuracy. See protocol.repeat for the number of observations.

definitions.correctedCopyDetectionRate: A generated assertion fails on original code and passes on a separately corrected copy. References are checked by fixed external contract witnesses. This is specific seeded-fault evidence, not independent semantic accuracy.
definitions.preservedDetectionRate: Final detection among runs with an initial detection; requires a usable final probe. No initial detections means unavailable.
definitions.latency: Wall time for the complete agent run, including failed runs; excludes external corrected-copy probes. Grouped by repeated run, not by project-independent samples.
definitions.mutation: Paired raw killed counts require complete measurements, identical scope, mutant IDs and diffs. They are not a relevance/equivalence-reviewed mutation score.
definitions.tokens: Provider-reported tokens; failed requests without usage make totals unavailable. No currency cost is inferred.
definitions.missing: Every planned run stays in completion denominators. Missing observations remain unavailable rather than zero.
definitions.semanticMetrics: Independent semantic accuracy, diagnosis F1, finding precision/recall and reviewed mutation scores remain unavailable without human-reviewed references and outputs.
definitions.referenceFailureRate: Runs whose final generated suite still has a failed assertion on a separately replayed, fixed-witness-validated reference copy. This is a reference disagreement, not independently established false-positive precision. Errors, skips, empty suites and incomplete replays remain unavailable.
definitions.stability: Distinct approved-suite hashes describe literal output variation only. One repeat cannot measure repeatability; matching hashes do not prove semantic correctness.
